name: Deco AI
description: Learns your decoration style and decorates whole sections of your level for you. Runs fully offline.

density.name: Density
density.description: Chance (0 to 1) that each exposed edge gets decorated. Lower values look more natural and less repetitive.

max-objects.name: Max objects per run
max-objects.description: Safety cap on how many objects one press of Deco! can place.
